mainEntity.name: How do I prepare a sermon or a lesson?

acceptedAnswer.text: Projects keep the passages, notes and tasks a sermon or lesson is made from. Type "project" and a reference in the palette to add a passage to the open project.

mainEntity.name: How do I share a project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Export it as its own file to open whole in this app elsewhere, or as Markdown for anyone. Passages are kept as references, so they read correctly in any translation.
